module: Manages the special stage start clocks (physical signs present in the levels) for rally. It loads the clock types from `lua/ge/extensions/gameplay/rally/startClocks/*.lua` (each must expose `textures`, `findClocks` and `draw`), creates a display TSStatic object for each clock found, draws the wall time, the "SS<n>" label and the countdown (with light code R, A or G) into dynamic textures, then, if the `rallyStartCountdownDisplay` setting is '3d', shows the clock nearest to the start line in an inset render view at the top of the screen with a frame colored according to the light. It feeds its state from the `onRallyDataUpdated` hook.
notes: A valid clock type is a startClocks/ module that returns a table with `textures` (key -> {tag, width, height, clearColor} table), `findClocks()` (list of clocks {shapeName, transform, scale, anchor}) and `draw(textures, display)`. getView(clock, startLine, targetPos) is optional. Invalid modules are logged as errors.
`display` table passed to draw: {clock = 'HH:MM:SS', clockSeconds, label = 'SSn', countdown, countdownSeconds, semaphore = 'R'|'A'|'G'}.
Countdown: light R beyond 5 s, A at 5 s or less, G after the start (shows '0' then '-1' to '-5', 6 s in total); then '-' in red. Beyond 60 s, shown as m:ss.

The wall time comes from the RallyLoopManager (getWallClockTimeSecs) if a loop is active, otherwise from rallyClock.wallClockSecs received by onRallyDataUpdated, otherwise from core_environment.getTimeOfDay (shifted by 12 h: (time + 0.5) % 1 x 86400).
The clocks are searched once per second while none is valid; the textures are re-bound 4 times (every 0.5 s) after creation.

The 3D view fades out 1.5 s after the end of the countdown and is available (isRenderViewAvailable) only from the second valid frame. The chosen clock is the one within 20 m of the special stage start line (gameplay_rally:getRallyManager():getSSStartLinePos()).
Minor bug: getStageDisplay writes 'SS' .. tostring(label):gsub(...): gsub returns two values but the concatenation keeps only one, so with no visible effect.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Load hook: loads (or reloads) the clock types from the startClocks folder.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Unload hook: destroys the render view, the displays and resets the state.

onRallySessionEnd.desc: Hook emitted at the end of a rally session: same cleanup as unload.

onRallyDataUpdated.desc: Hook called when the rally data changes. Reads activeState (start and end of the countdown, 1.5 s delay of the 3D view), rallyClock.wallClockSecs and startClockCountdownData (or countdownData) to compute the start time (timeUntilLaunch in seconds, state 'launched').

onUpdate.desc: Update hook: (re)detects the level's clocks every second if needed, rebinds the textures, runs the view delay and updates the 3D render view.

onPreRender.desc: Called before rendering, after all onUpdate: advances the local clock if no fresh data has arrived, redraws the textures if the display changed and draws the colored frame of the 3D view.

isRenderViewAvailable.desc: Indicates whether the countdown's 3D render view is active; rallyLoop uses it to hide the 2D countdown.

returns.desc: true if the 3D view is available.
List of {name, module} (name = file name without extension).
